form.official-title: To amend the Federal Water Pollution Control Act with respect to San Francisco Bay restoration, and for other purposes.

section.text: Section 125 of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1276a) is amended—

paragraph.text: in the section heading, by striking grant; and

subparagraph.text: in the subsection heading, by striking Grant program and inserting Program implementation;

in paragraph (1), by striking or other means to State and local agencies, special districts, and public or nonprofit agencies and inserting interagency agreements, contracts, or other funding mechanisms to Federal, State, and local agencies, special districts, public or nonprofit agencies, and other public or private entities; and
by striking paragraph (2) and inserting the following:

paragraph.text: Amounts provided for a project, activity, or study under this section shall not exceed an amount that is equal to 75 percent of the total cost of such project, activity, or study.

subparagraph.text: Not less than 25 percent of the cost of any project, activity, or study carried out using amounts provided to a non-Federal entity under this section shall be provided from non-Federal sources.
No Federal funds may be provided under this section to any non-Federal entity—

clause.text: that is domiciled in, headquartered in, or organized under the laws of, or the principal place of business of which is located in, a foreign country of concern (as defined in section 10638 of the Research and Development, Competition, and Innovation Act (42 U.S.C. 19237)); or
that has in place any agreement or partnership with a foreign country of concern.
